第23章 小风岗测试 小广场危机（第1页）
郑风一行人一下传送阵，就见识了小风岗的欢迎场面。
猛烈罡风呼呼作响，小风岗风一点不小，修为低的武者根本招架不住，好在山岗也不小，不然一帮天神境武者根本招架不住，差一点就被吹落下山岗。
郑风看到康昊不动声色，站得稳稳当当，景儿也很轻松。青鱼和郑杰有些皱眉并无大碍，其余人大都吃力。
郑风迎着罡风站到众人面前，自身就是移动阵盘，吸收了大部分风力。
郑风感觉这是剑门对通过传送阵到小风岗学员的测试。
这个测试对众人修行有一定的作用，所以没有将罡风全部吸收，郑风体内可是有风神珠。这点风还不够塞牙缝，风雷渊可是风雷宗测试场，那里虽是下界，仅风的威力却比这个测试强大不知凡几，郑风当时可是赤身裸体享受狂虐。
康昊见郑风不但没有受到丝毫影响还为众人挡住了大半风力，很是惊讶，康昊自己轻松，但要像郑风护住众人还游刃有余，就这一点，郑风的修为肯定不同凡响。
景儿发丝飘扬，看着郑风的眼神很是崇拜，风哥哥一直对众人照顾有加，总是那么贴心。
待众人享受了罡风一炷香得狂虐，郑风指着前面一块碑石说道。
“前面石碑上有提示：参加测试的少年到小风岗下面的青山小广场！”
沿石碑上一个红色箭头所指方向走出数万米，看到山岗下一个大大的数百万平米的广场，出现在众人视线内。
郑风对神界的“小”有了认知，小风岗，小广场，感觉应该是迷你型，然而在天元大陆众人看来，这就是巨大，飓风、大广场。
郑风一行人到了广场发现广场中央有一座高台，上面端坐了几人，服饰统一，胸口上都有一把金色小剑的图案，白色的袍子很是亮眼。中间一人年长一些，袍子下摆是金色山峰图案。左右都是少年，袍子下摆是青色山峰图案。他们身后站着一群少年衣服却是各有不同。但有相同之处就是腰间都挂有一个牌子，脸上都一副傲娇。
“郑风大哥，看到台上站着那群少年腰间的牌子没有？那就是“免试令牌”，代表那些少年具有免试资格。”康昊的提醒，让郑风想到了康昊原本也是可以站到台上具有免试资格的一员。
然而看到康昊眼神中只是一闪而过的不快后，脸上就微笑起来，郑风明白定是康昊有所触动，但最终放下了。
“兄弟一会我们七人上去测试。”大家看着郑风都有些好奇。
“青鱼和郑杰也可以试试，其实我有一种想法，沐沐哥和沁阳兄弟也可以去试试，你们四人虽然修为没有达到高阶武君，但青鱼修行阵道、郑杰炼体、沐沐和沁阳修行丹道，对剑门来说应该可以算是特长生。”郑风的声音特别大声。引得众人都把目光聚了过来。

“特长生？剑门就是修行剑道，什么时候开始招所谓的特长生，大伙有谁知道？”一个少年长得敦实，眯着眼大声的问，其实不是他想眯着眼装深沉而是胖得睁不开眼。
“没听说过，我大哥就是剑门外门弟子，没有听他说起过。”一少女声音悦耳，说话声音不大，但众人都听到了。知道少女大哥是剑门外门弟子后都向少女靠近过去，想打探消息。
“从没听说有这么一回事！”有人说得十分肯定。
“说不好是这少年哗众取宠。”一大叔见大伙都没听说。
“台上的主考大人，有特长生的名额吗？”郑风大声朝着台上几位剑门人员大喊。
郑风想起景儿最早被天武帝都灵剑宗按照特长生破格录取的。觉得可以为青鱼、郑杰、妙沁阳、沐沐四人争取一下。
“哪里来的小子，懂不懂规矩？为哗众取宠，竟然信口开河！”台上最左边的白袍少年，早就听到郑风的声音，对郑风的说法十分不喜。他清楚知道，剑门此次预选并没有什么特长生的说法。看到台下乱哄哄的议论后，就想冒火，现在不是私下说说，还公然询问，这不是给选拔测试添乱嘛。

Chapter 23 Xiaofenggang Test Small Square Crisis (Page 1)
As soon as Zheng Feng and his party entered the teleportation formation, they saw the welcoming scene at Xiaofeng Gang.
The strong wind roared, and the wind in the small wind hill was not small at all. Warriors with low cultivation levels could not resist it. Fortunately, the hill was not small either. Otherwise, a group of warriors in the realm of gods would not be able to resist it and would almost be blown off the hill.
Zheng Feng saw that Kang Hao was calm and steady, and Jing'er was also very relaxed. Qing Yu and Zheng Jie frowned a little, which was fine, but most of the others were struggling.
Zheng Feng stood in front of everyone facing the strong wind. He was a mobile formation disk, absorbing most of the wind force.
Zheng Feng felt that this was Jianmen's test for the students who had passed through the teleportation array to Xiaofeng Gang.
This test has a certain effect on everyone's practice, so it did not absorb all the Gang Feng. Zheng Feng did have the Wind God Bead in his body. This wind is not enough to fill your teeth. Fengleiyuan is the Fenglei Sect's testing ground. Although it is the lower realm, the power of the wind alone is infinitely more powerful than this test. Zheng Feng was naked and enjoying the violent torture.
Kang Hao was surprised to see that Zheng Feng not only was not affected at all but also blocked most of the wind for everyone. Kang Hao was relaxed on his own, but he was able to protect everyone like Zheng Feng. In this regard, Zheng Feng's cultivation must be extraordinary.
Jing'er's hair was flying, and she looked at Zheng Feng with admiration in her eyes. Brother Feng had always taken good care of everyone and was always so considerate.
When everyone was enjoying the incense of Gangfeng and was furious, Zheng Feng pointed to a stone tablet in front and said.
"There is a reminder on the stone tablet in front: the teenagers who take the test should go to the small Qingshan Square under Xiaofeng Gang!"
After walking tens of thousands of meters in the direction pointed by a red arrow on the stone monument, we saw a large square of millions of square meters under the hill, appearing in everyone's sight.
Zheng Feng has an understanding of the "smallness" of the God Realm. The small wind hill and the small square feel like they should be mini. However, in the eyes of everyone in Tianyuan Continent, they are huge, like hurricanes and big squares.
Zheng Feng and his party arrived at the square and found that there was a high platform in the center of the square, with several people sitting on it. They were uniformly dressed, with a golden sword pattern on their chests, and their white robes were very eye-catching. The middle one is older, and the hem of his robe has a golden mountain pattern. There are young men on the left and right, and the hem of their robes has a blue mountain pattern. Behind them stood a group of teenagers wearing different clothes. But the one thing they have in common is that they all have a brand hanging on their waists and a look of arrogance on their faces.
"Brother Zheng Feng, have you seen the signs on the waists of the teenagers standing on the stage? That is the "Exemption Token", which means that those teenagers have the qualification to be exempted from the exam." Kang Hao's reminder reminded Zheng Feng that Kang Hao was also one of the people who could stand on the stage and have the qualification to be exempted from the exam.
However, after seeing just a flash of displeasure in Kang Hao's eyes, a smile appeared on his face. Zheng Feng understood that Kang Hao must have been touched, but finally let it go.
"Brother, seven of us will go up for the test in a minute." Everyone looked at Zheng Feng with curiosity.
"Qingyu and Zheng Jie can also give it a try. In fact, I have an idea that Brother Mu Mu and Qinyang can also give it a try. Although the four of you have not reached high-level martial arts, Qingyu practices formation, Zheng Jie practices body training, and Mu Mu and Qinyang practice alchemy. They should be considered special talents for Jianmen." Zheng Feng's voice was particularly loud. It attracted everyone's attention.
"Specialty students? Jianmen is a kendo practitioner. When will we start recruiting so-called specialty students? Does anyone know?" A stocky boy asked loudly with squinted eyes. In fact, it was not that he wanted to squint to look serious but that he was too fat to open his eyes.
"I've never heard of it. My eldest brother is an outer disciple of Jianmen. I've never heard of him talking about it." A young girl said with a sweet voice.The voice was not loud, but everyone heard it. After knowing that the girl's eldest brother was an outer disciple of Jianmen, they all approached the girl and wanted to find out the news.
"I've never heard of such a thing!" someone said with certainty.
"Maybe this young man is just trying to please everyone." The uncle didn't hear anything about it when he saw it.
"Master examiner on the stage, are there any places for students with special talents?" Zheng Feng shouted loudly to several Jianmen personnel on the stage.
Zheng Feng remembered that Jing'er was the first to be admitted by Emperor Tianwu's Duling Sword Sect based on special talents. I think I can fight for Qing Yu, Zheng Jie, Miao Qinyang and Mu Mu.
"Where does this kid come from? Do you know the rules? To impress people, you talk nonsense!" The young man in white robe on the far left of the stage had heard Zheng Feng's voice long ago and was very unhappy with what Zheng Feng said. He knew clearly that there were no special talents in Jianmen's preliminary selection. After seeing the commotion in the audience, I wanted to get angry. Instead of talking privately, I asked openly. Wouldn't this add chaos to the selection test?
